correctness.basis: Main chains and edge quantifiers reconstructed; no material failure found. Foundational imported theorems not all independently reproved.

rigor.basis: Fixed-reference pinching, normalized TRE, separable fidelity limit, exact physical types and finite-noise common code are justified; exposition is dense and dependency audit is bounded.

novelty.basis: Credits operational minimax combination and sharp iff, not prior Gram/Choi/coding machinery. Directed search found no exact prior theorem but is not exhaustive.

significance.basis: Strong result for a specialized assisted reset/thermal asymptotic; critical curves, practical blocklength and broader communication regimes remain open.

reproducibility.basis: Frozen hashes and all three programs independently rerun in a new working copy with byte-identical results; supplied implementations only and finite diagnostic scope.

scientific_conclusion: The stated complete Shannon and fixed finite super-Shannon assisted minimax curves hold iff n=o(E), and the corresponding unknown fixed signal family iff N=o(E), under the stated fixed-channel coding order and physical expected-energy constraint. No material objection found.
